preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 50000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 100000 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('2')])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of sets n is an integer between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(elements) <= 100000 and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in elements) for elements in [set(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1])
preconditions.description: Each set contains at least 2 distinct integers, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(set(map(int, line.split()[1:]))) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all sets in all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (len(line.strip().split()) == 2 and all(x.isdigit() for x in line.strip().split()) and int(line.strip().split()[0]) != int(line.strip().split()[1]) and 1 <= int(line.strip().split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.strip().split()[1]) <= n) for line, n in zip(stdout_text.strip().splitlines(), [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('2')]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or two distinct integers between 1 and n (inclusive) representing set indices.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1' and len([i for i, s in enumerate(sets, 1) for j, t in enumerate(sets, 1) if i < j and len(s & t) >= 2]) == 0) or (len(line.strip().split()) == 2 and len(sets[int(line.strip().split()[0])-1] & sets[int(line.strip().split()[1])-1]) >= 2) for line, sets in zip(stdout_text.strip().splitlines(), [ [set(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in case_lines[1:]] for case_lines in [stdin_text.splitlines()[i:i+int(stdin_text.splitlines()[i-1])+1] for i in range(1, len(stdin_text.splitlines())) if i-1 < len(stdin_text.splitlines()) and stdin_text.splitlines()[i-1].strip().isdigit()]])
postconditions.description: If the output is '-1', no pair of sets shares at least two common elements; otherwise, the two reported indices correspond to sets that share at least two common elements.
